name: gitfolio
description: Your portfolio, resume and tech stack career from your own git history, written by your AI tool from GitFolio's facts and your answers.

interface.shortDescription: Portfolio, resume and tech career from your git history
interface.longDescription: Gives your AI tool the facts of your development work as GitFolio collects them on this computer - periods, commit types, kinds of work, languages, tech stack periods, developer type - so it can interview you briefly and write your portfolio, resume or tech stack career. Sets GitFolio up with your email; you decide what each repository shows. Needs the GitFolio CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use GitFolio to write my portfolio for this job posting.
Use GitFolio to set up GitFolio for this repository.
Use GitFolio to explain my developer type and scores.
